title: What Orbital Ring Cities Is
definition: Orbital Ring Cities: cities on rings encircling the planet in low orbit.
description:

t: Real Research Today: Orbital Ring Cities
title: Real Research Today: Orbital Ring Cities
definition: Today's documented research behind Orbital Ring Cities.
description:
The road to Orbital Ring Cities is already being paved. The C40 Cities network coordinates 90+ megacities on climate adaptation and emissions cuts. Masdar City in Abu Dhabi was designed as a zero-carbon, car-free urban laboratory.

China's sponge city program rebuilds urban water systems to absorb floodwater. Together these programs form the orbital districts foundation that Orbital Ring Cities will build on — the shuttle transit results, the spin gravity methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as shuttle transit research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

t: 2030 — The first ring hulls district opens at 50
title: 2030 — The first ring hulls district opens at 50
definition: 2030 milestone on the Orbital Ring Cities roadmap.
description:
The first ring hulls district opens at 50,000 residents, its orbital districts grid and shuttle transit mobility running at full design load.

What must be true first: the orbital districts results have to replicate outside the lab, shuttle transit manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and spin gravity operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed orbital districts demonstrations, shuttle transit cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting spin gravity uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Orbital Ring Cities
definition: Estimates Orbital Ring Cities readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Orbital Ring Cities components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a ring hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

definition: Simulates Orbital Ring Cities operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Orbital Ring Cities installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 61343 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where orbital districts monitoring, shuttle transit redundancy, or spin gravity maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Orbital Ring Cities Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Orbital Ring Cities: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Orbital Ring Cities — cities on rings encircling the planet in low orbit.

Phase 1 — Prove (orbital districts): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (shuttle transit): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (spin gravity): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (dock blocks): ring hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and low orbit-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
